//: AIC Firestore emulator config. The 'firestore' block wires the rules + indexes files into the emulator so it ENFORCES them exactly like prod. Without the rules key the emulator runs fully OPEN (allow all) and gives a false sense of security.

emulators.//: host MUST be 0.0.0.0 (not the 127.0.0.1 default) so other compose services and the host can reach the emulator over the compose network â€” the #1 Docker failure mode (firebase-tools issue #1976). LAN exposure is prevented at the HOST publish layer: docker-compose.yml binds the published ports to 127.0.0.1. These two settings are complementary: 0.0.0.0 = in-container bind; 127.0.0.1 = host-side bind.

ui.//: Free Emulator Suite UI: live data browser/editor + Rules Playground (for testing default-deny / immutable audit_log) + request monitor. Directly supports the security-audit deliverable. SECURITY NOTE (audit, low): the Suite UI is an UNAUTHENTICATED full read/write surface that bypasses firestore.rules â€” anyone who reaches :4000 can edit/delete any doc including audit_log. It must NEVER be published beyond 127.0.0.1 (the compose host bind enforces this). It has no prod analogue, so the only risk is dev-box exposure.
